title: Scoped negative result: simultaneous full pair/triple exchanges do not beat SW4 (seed 29)
body:
Negative result / independent verification. No new kappa, no certificate change.

Base: f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631. Track 20-39 complex supplier, seed 29.

Question: can simultaneous full entering-copy read-set exchanges on the pinned P6k4 complex word beat the four-exchange SW4 word? Tested all C(38,2)=703 pairs and C(38,3)=8436 triples of legal full single-pair exchanges, applied at once on bare P6k4 with exact frame refit. All 9139 frame-legal, all conserve rank mass 5634, none beats SW4 (best pair +0.00349, best triple +0.00175 above SW4 by floating-cost proxy; zero dominate componentwise). 38 legal fulls fall into exactly three profile-delta classes; SW4 equals 4x one single delta; 679/703 pairs exactly additive.

Files (all new, research/sw4-fullpair-seed29/): search.py, verify.py, CANDIDATES.json, EVIDENCE.json.gz, EXPECTED.json, README.md, CLAIM.md, NOTICE.md, SOURCES.json, VALIDATION.md, inputs/P6K4-WORD.json.gz. upstream/ untouched. Prepared with help from opencode.

Reproduce: python3 -B -I research/sw4-fullpair-seed29/verify.py -> PASS_SW4_FULLPAIR_SEED29 pairs=703 triples=8436 legal=9139 no_beats_sw4 (about 75s, stdlib only).

Overlap checked against #867, #873 (different objects), [PR 775](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/775) (excludes this class; used read-only as 703/703 cross-check), concurrent [PR 874](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/874) (complementary, cross-cited). Scope and open obligations in README/VALIDATION.
